items.name: Zinley
items.tagline: Your Personal AI Representative for calls, email, and tasks
items.description: Most AI waits inside a chat. Zinley is reachable by you and the people around you. With its own phone number and email, it answers calls, handles email, books things, and gets work done within your rules. It remembers your people and relationships, then reports back in your language. Not another chatbot. A second you that shows up.

items.name: Capptivo
items.tagline: Free open-source screen recorder & demo editor
items.description: Capptivo is a free, open-source screen recorder and demo editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Record locally, add follow-cursor zooms, polish the look, burn on-device captions, and export, no account, no subscription. Give your demos the spotlight they deserve.

items.name: YourSitee
items.tagline: Make your bio link worth clicking
items.description: YourSitee turns your scattered online presence into one visual page that feels like you, not another list of buttons. Build with 20+ widgets, import your Linktree with AI, and see what people click with built-in analytics. All your links. One place.

items.name: Lumichats
items.tagline: A Claude Code alternative for people who avoid the terminal
items.description: 70,000 people use LumiChats in a browser and kept asking for the one thing a browser cannot do: touch their files. So we built the desktop one. It runs commands on your machine, writes real documents, and you pay only for the work you run.

items.name: Zen Whisper
items.tagline: On-device Mac dictation that types into any app
items.description: Hold a shortcut and dictate into any Mac app without sending audio to the cloud. Zen Whisper keeps core speech recognition on-device, with local models, searchable transcripts, voice memos, media transcription, and Pro tools for larger models and translation.

items.name: Finamie
items.tagline: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights
items.description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

items.name: Termexo
items.tagline: A local Windows workbench for Claude Code and Codex
items.description: Termexo brings Claude Code and Codex into one recoverable Windows workspace. Arrange real PTY terminals in custom grids, search and resume native sessions, get notified when an agent needs approval, and switch Claude-compatible model profiles without rebuilding environment variables. Local-first, no Termexo account required.

items.name: Bolcho AI
items.tagline: Build Voice AI agents that actually speak India
items.description: Bolcho AI is an AI voice platform that helps businesses build, deploy and scale multilingual AI phone and web agents. Unlike generic Voice AI platforms, Bolcho is built for India—with native language support, ultra-low latency, telephony integrations, and the flexibility to bring your own LLMs, STT, and TTS providers. From sales and support to appointment booking and customer engagement, launch production-ready voice agents in minutes.

items.name: TimeOS 2.0
items.tagline: Work your tasks. Bill your clients with confidence.
items.description: Two years since the first TimeOS! And It's time for 2.0 update! TimeOS 2.0 closes the loop with companion Invoicing app. Hit Load, then Generate PDF and your sessions become line items! Customize the invoice if needed, download the PDF and sent to the client.

items.name: FreqWave EQ
items.tagline: Customize your web audio with a real-time EQ
items.description: 8-band Web Audio Equalizer - fixing muddy podcasts, harsh streams and quiet dialogue. Featuring EQ modes and DSP Compression.
